_comment: Confirmed bookings. These are the baseline for their leg: an alternative is only interesting if it beats this price. The booking price also becomes the effective ceiling for the leg, so options between the old band max and the booking stay visible instead of being hidden as above_band. Prices are per night, taxes included, as quoted by the booking. `lat`/`lon` are a fallback used only until the monitor observes the property itself and supplies real coordinates; both were sourced from the hotels' published addresses because neither had coordinates in the collected data (Roma only ever appeared in exclusion rows, Veneza was seen once before coordinates were recorded).
